source_name: MCA Company Master Data (data.gov.in / OGD API)
organization: Ministry of Corporate Affairs (republished via NIC data.gov.in)
rate_limits: free API key (public sample key works); per-key limits apply
notes: Authoritative MCA company master data keyed on CIN (21-char). 128 'Company Master Data' resources (state x year). Open via the OGD REST API under GODL-India. Verified live with the public sample key. Includes authorized & paid-up capital but NOT full financial statements. 2021 schema adds industrial_class, email_addr (PII), latest_year_ar/bs filing markers.

source_name: MCA21 portal — Company/LLP master data & public documents
rate_limits: WAF protected; returned HTTP 403 to this client
notes: The live MCA register. Free 'View Company Master Data' lookup by CIN; full documents (annual financials AOC-4/XBRL, etc.) are pay-per-document under 'View Public Documents'. WAF-blocked (403) to automated clients. Cataloged from public docs only; use data.gov.in for open bulk.

Full company financial statements are filed with MCA (AOC-4, XBRL for larger companies) and are pay-per-document via MCA21 'View Public Documents'. No open bulk. The data.gov.in master data only carries capital + latest filing-year markers, not the statements. Cataloged from public docs only.

organization: BSE Ltd / National Stock Exchange / SEBI
notes: For listed companies only (CIN starts with 'L'). Quarterly/annual financial results and shareholding via BSE/NSE; under exchange terms of use. Join to MCA via CIN/ISIN. Not fetched here; cataloged as the open route to listed financials.
